hook.name: Portorium
hook.description: Single-pool hook that charges an exact-input swap fee (1–2%, read from an external Forum oracle with a 1% fallback) in the input currency. When ROME is the input, the fee is burned immediately; when ETH is the input, it accumulates as ERC-6909 claims until anyone calls tribute(), which sends half to a fixed treasury (aerarium) and uses the rest to buy and burn ROME.
